title: The Darkest Little Sky
skyStory: Zero percent. The new moon in Pisces is fully hidden, the darkest night of the cycle, and the stars take full advantage, coming out in their best outfits. Orion is wearing a belt with extra sparkle. Without the moon to boss them around, the constellations are throwing a quiet party. It is a good night to let go of something and watch it float off into the dark.

reading: There is something heavy you have been carrying since February. Maybe a grudge against a printer. Maybe a promise you made to yourself that does not fit anymore. Tonight, under the darkest sky of the month, you are allowed to set it down.

Go outside, if the wind allows, and look up for one full minute. Find the brightest star you can. Tell it, silently, the thing you are letting go. Then turn around and walk back to the warm cabin without looking back, like a hero in a film walking away from a grand finale of fireworks. The [[Death]] card is not scary. It just means one chapter ends so the next can begin.
joel.mission: Step outside tonight, find the brightest star, and silently hand it one thing you are done carrying.
joel.omen: A star that seems to twinkle twice as fast as the others. It means the universe heard you and said got it.

reading: The Wood Rat is a famously excellent judge of what to keep and what to toss. Tonight you get to apply that talent to something invisible: an old worry, a story you have been telling yourself, a should that belongs to somebody else.

Write it on a scrap of paper. Then fold it into the smallest possible square, as small as your fingers can manage. Put it in a drawer you never open, or in the recycling. As the moon starts growing again tomorrow, so does the space where that worry used to be. You will notice the room by Friday. Saturn has already measured it and approves.
nancy.mission: Fold one worry written on paper into the smallest square you can manage, then hide it somewhere you never look.
nancy.omen: A clear night sky, even for a moment between clouds. It means the path ahead is clearer than you think.
nancy.elementWhy: bury the worry, plant the space

together.text: Darkest night of the month. Both of you name, privately, one thing to release. Then send each other a single star emoji at exactly 9 pm. The stars are watching the clock, and they love a synchronized ritual.
